title: Apply for an additional Mobility Parking Scheme permit (individual)
summary: Learn how to apply for an additional Mobility Parking Scheme permit card if you own two eligible vehicles.
intro:
If you're eligible for a Mobility Parking Scheme (MPS) permit, you can apply for 2 permit cards if you have a standard vehicle and an open-style vehicle registered in your name or joint names.

In exceptional situations only, you can get a second permit for your work needs.

Examples of an open-style vehicle are convertible sports car, motorcycle or motor tricycle.

You can request an additional card when you apply for a permit at a Service NSW Centre.

If you already have an MPS card and you apply for a second card, you'll need to surrender your existing card when you apply for the second card. Your existing permit cannot be a temporary permit.
who_can_apply: Cannot walk because of permanent or temporary loss of use of one or both legs, or other permanent medical or physical condition.
Physical condition is detrimentally affected as a result of walking 100 metres.
Need to use crutches, a walking frame, callipers, scooter, wheelchair, or other similar mobility aid.
Applicants with an intellectual, psychiatric, or cognitive impairment must meet at least one of the above eligibility criteria.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Mobility Parking Scheme Application (Individual or Temporary)'.
Proof of identity (if using a Medicare card, it must be the plastic card, not the digital version).
One of the following documents if the open-style vehicle is registered in joint names.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and take the required documents to a service centre to submit your application.

more_info.text: inadequate muscular control to meet photo requirements
mostly bedridden due to advanced age or terminal illness
severe disability that stops you from attending a service centre

To apply for a photo exemption, send a letter of request along with a completed application form and a supporting letter from your doctor, to:
DRIVES Assurance Transport for NSW PO Box 3035 Parramatta NSW 2124
If approved, you'll be sent a letter of exemption.
When you get an MPS permit, you'll also be issued an Australian Disability Parking permit (large purple card). You must display both permits to get parking concessions.
If your permit holder is lost or damaged, you can get a replacement free of charge at a service centre.

faqs.q: Can I get a second Mobility Parking Scheme permit card?
faqs.a: Yes, you can apply for two permit cards if you have a standard vehicle and an open-style vehicle registered in your name or joint names.
Examples of an open-style vehicle include a convertible sports car, motorcycle, or motor tricycle.

faqs.q: What happens if I already have an MPS card and apply for a second one?
faqs.a: You must surrender your existing card when you apply for the second card. Your existing permit cannot be a temporary permit.
